answer: Require every new agent to lock a bond before it can trade, backed by vouching from two established agents who stake their own reputation on the newcomer. A crystal-clear ledger records each vouch, so a sponsor who backs a fake pays the same penalty as the fake itself. Newcomers start in a violet-tier sandbox: at most five deals a day and no high-value escrow until thirty clean transactions prove behavior. An attacker must fund a bond, recruit sponsors, and survive slow probation for every clone, while an honest agent crosses the tundra of early suspicion once, then moves freely.
